verbetes.glosa_atual: depósito; celeiro; armazém de provisões.
definicoes_originais: (כלב; v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.; cmp. כְּלוּב, כְּלִיבָה; Var. lect.
notas_originais: אַכְלְכָא, v. infra) shed, store-room. B. Mets. 63 b חיטי … באַכְלְבָאִי (v. Var. lect. in Rabb. D. S. a. l.; Mss. a. Ar. אכלכא) would my wheat have gone to ruin in my granary? Taan. 24 a (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).— Pl. אַכְלְבֵי. Gitt. 56 a אכלבא … שתין א' וכ' one shed of wheat requires sixty sheds of wood (for baking). B. Mets. 72 b חיטי דא' (Ms. M. באכלכי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) wheat stored in granaries &c.

notas_originais: Kidd. 81 b top. א' שדא ביה כיחו he coughed, and threw his phlegm into the cup. [Perh. כסא אַ' a black, dirty cup?]

verbetes.glosa_atual: exedra; pórtico coberto diante da casa; sala de conversa ou discussão.
definicoes_originais: (ἐξέδρα, exedra) (Greek) a covered place in front of the house; (Roman) recess, parlor, hall for conversations and discussions.
notas_originais: Targ. Jud. III, 23. [ Pl. Targ. Ps. CIV, 3, v. אִינְדְּרָא.] B. Bath. 11 b א' דבי רב the hall of the school house (philosophers’ exedra, v. Sm. Ant. s. v.), contrad. to א' רומייתא (Ms. Oxf. דרומיתא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) Roman exedra (open but surrounded by a railing). Ib. 25 ab עולם לא' וכ' the world resembles an exedra the northernmost side of which is not covered (מסוככת Ms. M., ed. מסובבת not surrounded); a. fr.— Pl. אַכְסַדְרָאֹות. Tam. 28 b א' של בנין exedras forming, or belonging to, a structure (opp. to open exedra with plants).

verbetes.glosa_atual: exílio; banimento; desterro, do grego ἐξορία.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 18 אכסי' (Ar. כסוריא) (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: leitura a corrigir para expressão que significa tampa de baú.
notas_originais: Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 4 א' קמטרא, read with R. S. to Kel. X, 1 עף [אף] כסוי קמטרא also the lid of a chest.

verbetes.glosa_atual: molho condimentado com vinagre e garum; também molho de vegetais.
definicoes_originais: (ὀξύγαρον, oxygarum) a sauce of vinegar and garum; in gen. a sauce of all kinds of vegetables.
notas_originais: Ber. 35 b bot. Ms. M. (ed. אנס'); Yoma 76 a; Shebu. 23 a. Tosef. Bets. II, 16. Y. Shebi. VIII, 38 a top אָקְסִי'; Tosef. Ter. IX, 10; ib. Shebi. VI, 3 סְנִיגְרֹון.— Pl. אָכְסִיגָרִיֹּות, abbrev. סִגָּרִיֹּות vegetable sauces, vegetables used for oxygarum. Shebi. IX, 5 ed. (Var. סנריות, סנדיות, סגדיות, Ms. M. הנידיות); Tosef. ib. VII, 13 אגוטרי read אָגְזוּגָרִין; Sifra B’har Par. II ch. 3 סנדריות (Rabad סנדיות; corr. acc.). [Koh. R. to XI, 9 ארגסטירין read אֹוגְסִיגָרִין.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: petição; solicitação; pedido, do grego ἀξίωμα.
notas_originais: Midr. Till. to Ps. VI, end אחרים מקבלים אנ' וכ' (corr. אכ') others receive the petition presented to him אני איני מבקש אלא אנסיומין שלי (corr. acc., insert שאתה תקבל) I only ask that thou mayest receive my petition thyself. Ib. to Ps. CII אל תתן א' שלי בתוכה (read שלו); [the entire passage is obscure and seems out of place].

verbetes.glosa_atual: carregador de lenha; trabalhador florestal, do grego ξύληγος.
notas_originais: Men. 97 a כליא' common wooden vessels; Ḥag. 26 b כלי אכסלגס Ar. (ed. אכסלגים Ms. M. אבלוגסין corr. acc.).—Zeb. 94 a כלי אַכְסִלְגְּיָא (Ms. M. אכסלמוס) forester’s apparel (leather covers &c.); v. אַבְלוּסְמֹוס.

notas_originais: , v. אַכְסִילְגֹּוס

verbetes.glosa_atual: leitura textual incerta para nome de roupas, possivelmente vestes de algodão.
definicoes_originais: , Tosef. Kil. V, 26 (ed. Zuck. כליסים הגרגים, Var. כליסיס, אכסילין) prob. כלים אַכְסִילִינִין (ξύλινος) cotton clothes.

verbetes.glosa_atual: hospedar; receber como hóspede.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of אַכְסָן II) to harbor a guest.
notas_originais: Nithpa. נִתְאַכְסֵן to be received; to lodge with. Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVI.

verbetes.glosa_atual: pino de tecelão; estaca de tecelagem.
definicoes_originais: (transpos. of אסכנא, v. סִכָּא; h. יָתֵד) weaver’s pin.
notas_originais: Targ. Jud. XVI, 13; 14; a. fr.—*Sabb. 151 b אפי' מליא כא' דגרדאי Ms. Oxf. a. Ar. (ed. כאביסנא; Ms. M. מלי אכסניא וגרדאי) even if the painting stick is as thick (with paint) as a weaver’s pin.

notas_originais: pl. אַכְסָנִים, v. next art.

notas_originais: , read:

verbetes.glosa_atual: estrangeiro; hóspede; forasteiro; também soldado mercenário.
definicoes_originais: (deriv. of אַכְסַנְיָא) stranger, guest, lodger; also (ξένος) hired soldier.
notas_originais: Y. Erub. II, end 20 b יֵעָשֶׂה כא' let him be considered as a stranger (transient lodger). Tosef. Shebi. V, 21 אכסנא some ed. (ed. Zuck. אַכְסְנָיִין pl.) soldier, v. אַכְסַנְיָא 3).—Arakh. 16 b א' דאקראי an occasional guest. Ib. א' פוגם ונפגם a traveller (constantly changing his lodging place) discredits others a. himself; a. fr.— Pl. אַכְסְנָיִין (v. supra), אַכְסְנִין Lev. R. s. 27.—אַכְסְנֵי, אַכְסְנַיָּא, אַכְסְנָאֵי. Targ. Y. II Gen. XLVII, 21 א' גילולאי exiled strangers. Gen. R. s. 50 הב לאילין א' give these travellers &c.—*אַכְסָנִים. Num. R. s. 10 (p. 239 c ed. Amst.) מנהג הא' custom of hospitality [prob. אכסניא].

verbetes.glosa_atual: navio mercante de Alexandria; figuradamente, mastro muito alto e, ironicamente, cruz ou forca.
definicoes_originais: (v. אלכסנדרית) an Alexandrian merchantman (Alexandria navis); trnsf. a high mast (satyrically for cross, gallows).
notas_originais: Targ. II, Esth. VII, 10 the son of Hamdatha wants to ascend לא' דבר פנדירא (Ms. לאַלַכְסַ') the mast of the son of Pandira (is to be hanged). Neg. XII, 1 באכסנדריא (marginal vers. in Mishn. edit., text אסקריא, Var. אסדא, אכסדיא, אסכדיא q. v.) in the rigging

verbetes.glosa_atual: hospitalidade; alojamento; estalagem; hospedagem de tropas ou necessitados; também grupo em trânsito ou mendigo.
definicoes_originais: quarter given to troops on march or to transient poor men; also the passing troop, or the passing poor; (individ.) beggar.
a gathering of scholars entertained by the hospitable of the place.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 35 א' נעשו וכ' (Pes. 118 b, corr. acc) they were a lodging place to my children in Egypt (they offered hospitality to &c.).—בעל א' host. Pesik. R. s. 11; cmp. אוּשְׁפִּיזְכָן.—B. Mets. 85 a תורה מחזרת על א' שלה scholarship likes to come around to its inn again (to be hereditary in the family); a. fr.
B. Mets. 87 a one must inquire בא' שלו after the health of his hostess.

Targ. Job XXXI, 32; a. e.—B. Bath. 11 b א' לפי בני אדם the quartering (of soldiers takes place) in proportion to the number of inmates (of each house). Dem. III, 1; v. Y. ib. 23 b top. Tosef. Shebi. V, 21 אין מאכילין אכסניין וכ' ed. Zuck. (Var. את אכסניא) you are not allowed to give … to soldiers quartered with you. Y. Ber. IX, 13 b ההן א' עלובתא this poor beggar. Ib. א' עלו' poor beggars. Lev. R. s. 34. Lam. R. to I, 1 (חד מירו') בר נש א' a poor man.
Y. Ber. IV, 8 b top נפיק לא' leaving for the scholars’ meeting. Bab. ib. 63 b פתח בכבוד א' opened his speech in honor of hospitality to scholars.

verbetes.glosa_atual: condição de estrangeiro; exílio; soldo militar.
notas_originais: Sot. 36 b
Mekh. B’shall. Shirah 4; Yalk. Ex. 246; a. e. (interchanging with אפסניא q. v.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: intendente responsável por alojar estrangeiros ou soldados; oficial de aquartelamento.
definicoes_originais: (read אכסנופרוכא Xenoparochus) one who provides for strangers or soldiers, quartermaster.
notas_originais: Y. B. Kam. III, 3 c top ההן א' פ' … שרי למיחשדוניה וכ' (read למישחדוניה) it is permissible to bribe the quartermaster (to let you off) before the Romans enter (the place), but not after that (when one man’s release from quartering duty is a direct injury to the other inhabitants).

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma corrompida de lista de nomes gregos de peixes; reconstrução proposta na fonte.
notas_originais: 66 b, Ab. Zar. 39 a אקונס ואפונס … וא' (v. Var. lect. Rabb. D. S. a. l.), Tosef. Ḥull. III (IV), 27 קולייס ופולמוס כספתיאס אכנס וכ', restore (א)קולייס ופילמוס (א)כסיפיאס (כסיפייס) ואתניאס (ואתנייס) וכ' κολίας, πήλαμυς, ξίφιας, ἀθνίας, names of fishes (v. Greek Dict.) Colias, Pelamys, Xiphias, Athnias and Thunny; v. אֲטוּנָס.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אסכדיא e אכסנדריא, com variantes da Tosefta.
notas_originais: Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 5, v. אסכדיא a. אכסנדריא.—[V. also next w.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: por estimativa visual; em bloco; sem contar ou medir cada unidade.
definicoes_originais: (used as adverb; a comp. of אך a. סרח less or more, v. נכי) in a lump, on measuring by sight.
notas_originais: Dem. II, 5 (Ms. M. אסכרא); Y. ib. III, 23 c מוכרן א' he sells them in a lump (as many as there may be). Maas. Sh. IV, 2. Sifra B’ḥukk. Par. 4, ch. X; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: montar animal selado; cavalgar em jumento com sela.
definicoes_originais: (b. h. אָכַף, √כף, v. כפף), denomin. of אוכָּף, to ride on a saddled ass.
notas_originais: Nid. 14 a הא דמֵיכַף וכ' Ar. (ed. דמַכַּף = מְאַכַּף Pa.) in the one case it means that he rides on a saddled ass. [מיכף Snh. 36 a, v. כּוּף.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: carga; peso; utensílio para carregar, como padiola ou cesto de mão.
definicoes_originais: a contrivance to carry loads, as a hand-barrow or hand-basket.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 69 a אבני דא' stones to weight the sheaves down to protect them from the wind.
Sabb. 66 b חמרא דא', v. אָנְקִטְמִין. Bets. 30 a (var. אכיתפא on the shoulder, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִכְפַּת.
notas_originais: , v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: preocupação; cuidado; responsabilidade; encargo.
definicoes_originais: (אכף; cmp. b. h. אֶכֶף) burden, care, solicitude, followed by ל־ of the person concerned.
notas_originais: Targ. I. Chr. XXI, 13 אִיכַּפַת.—Y. Sot. V, 20 b top וביתא מאי אכפה ליה what concern is the Temple to him? Taan. 25 a מאי אי' לך why should that trouble thee? B. Mets. 40 a וכי מאי א' וכ' what do the mice care whether &c. Koh. R. to IV, 1 זה מה אי' ליה what concern is it to this one (if the other sinned), i.e. why should he suffer for it?; a. fr. Pesik. R. s. 10, beg. אי' להם will people care for them (miss them)? Git. 62 a מכפת לא אכפת ליה should he not care for it? Cmp. כפת.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver אִיכָּר.
notas_originais: , v. אִי'

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver כַּרְגָּא.
notas_originais: , v. כַּרְגָּא

verbetes.glosa_atual: repolho; couve, equivalente a כְּרוּב.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. III, 5 d top. Num. R. s. 7.—Y. Bets. V, 63 a קולסי א' cabbage heads.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cobertura; revestimento; camada que recobre.
notas_originais: א' אוכמין כקדרא a coating of blackness like a pot. Targ. Jer. VIII, 21 (h. text קדר). Targ. Joel II, 6; Nah. II, 11 (h. text פארור). Cmp. קְרוּם.

verbetes.glosa_atual: corrigir a leitura para אַכְרוּב, couve.
notas_originais: Y. Maasr. I, 48 d top, read אַכְרוּב; cmp. קֶלַח.

verbetes.glosa_atual: proclamação; anúncio oficial de venda pública.
notas_originais: f. h. = ch. אַכְרַזְתָּא. Y. Meg. IV, 75 b top, expl. אגרת בקורת, v. אִגֶּרֶת; Y. Keth. XI, 34 c; Y. Snh. I, 19 b top.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Acriziel; nome de anjo, interpretado como arauto de Deus.
definicoes_originais: [ the herald of God], Akhr’ziel, an angel.
notas_originais: Yalk. Deut. 940. Deut. R. s. 11 אכזרי' (corr. acc.)

verbetes.glosa_atual: edital de venda pública; anúncio; leilão.
definicoes_originais: (= h. הַכְרָזָה; כרּז) proclamation announcing public sale, whence, auction, cmp. אִגֶּרֶת.
notas_originais: —B. Mets. 35 b ימי א' time appointed for public sale. Keth. 100 b נכסי דא' property sold at auction. Ib. for capitation-tax &c. we sell בלא א' without previous announcement; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: provável leitura corrompida de referência às Ilhas Britânicas.
definicoes_originais: Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX, 5, Yalk. ib.
notas_originais: ברטניא pr. n., prob. a corrupt. of איי בריטניא Britannic Isles

verbetes.glosa_atual: balança; pesos; pesagem; equilíbrio.
definicoes_originais: (כרע) prop. balancing, hence balances, scales, weighing.
notas_originais: Pesik. B’shall. p. 82 a בא' דאכרעון וכ' in the way they weighed, they were weighed. [Cmp. Buber l. c. note 43.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: adequação; correção; uso apropriado.
notas_originais: Targ. Koh. X, 10.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ainda; até agora; mesmo agora; partícula argumentativa do Talmude.
definicoes_originais: (contr. of אַד כְּעַנְתָא הִי) a scholastic term in Talm. Bab., still, even now, yet.
notas_originais: Meg. 2 a וא' מבעי ליה וכ' and still the plural form is needed. Yoma 27 a; a. fr.—מִדְּאַכַּתִּי since, up to that time. R. Hash. 10 b

verbetes.glosa_atual: venenoso; vingativo; malévolo.
definicoes_originais: (אכת, v. P. Sm. 191; cmp. אכסא, עכס, עכסה, עכן) venomous, vindictive.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XII, 28 Ms. Luzz. (v. Pesh., a. LXX b. c.); [some ed. אבהתנא, v. בְּהֵת; עַוְתָנָא; h. text נתיבה אַל וכ'!]

verbetes.glosa_atual: esverdeado; afetado por praga ou doença vegetal.
notas_originais: , cmp. סמוקר) greenish, blighted. Y. Dem. II, beg. 22 b is there no rice in Hulta? א' הוא it is greenish.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Achteriel; atributo ou nome divino relacionado à coroa.
definicoes_originais: (כתר) [divine crown], pr. n. Akhtriel, a divine surname (attribute).
notas_originais: Ber. 7 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: Albam; método de substituição das letras hebraicas com deslocamento de onze posições.
definicoes_originais: Albam, a formula of permutation of letters wherein the first interchanges with the twelfth, the second with the thirteenth, &c. Num. R. s. 18 טבאל באלב"ם רמלא Tabel in Albam reads Ramla.
notas_originais: Sabb. 104 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: prefixo אַל־ equivalente a עַל, sobre ou encarregado de.
definicoes_originais: a prefix, = עַל; e.g. אַלְתּוּסְבְּרָאוֹת (= על האוצרות) appointed over treasures, v. אַ־.

verbetes.glosa_atual: não; jamais; partícula proibitiva, por vezes menos severa que לֹא.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) not, no (according to Talmud a milder form of prohibition than לֹא; v. Y. Pes. VI, 33 b).
notas_originais: Aboth I, 3.—אל תקרי (abbr. א"ת), v. אֶלָּא. Taan. 11 a א' יראה וכ' shall not live to see &c.; a. v. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: a; para; em direção a; preposição.
definicoes_originais: אול to turn) prep. to, toward.
notas_originais: — Pl., with prefix מ a. suffix of pers. pron., of itself, of my ( his &c.) own accord, on my ( his &c.) authority. Yoma 5 b לא מֵאֵלַי not on my own authority. Orlah I, 2 העולה מֵאֵלָיו growing spontaneously.—Y. Peah VII, 20 b bot. its sacred character מֵאֵלָיו למדו they did derive from itself (i.e. from the wording of the law itself).—Hence מִמֵּילָא, v. מֵילָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Deus; divindade; forma אֵל.

verbetes.glosa_atual: senão; exceto; somente; mas; partícula de exclusão ou inferência.
definicoes_originais: (ellipt.) (you cannot say anything except …) but, a logical inference excluding all other explanations &c. Ib.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Ex. XV, 11 לית אִ' את none but thou, none besides thee; a. e.—Ber. V, 1 אין עומדין … א' וכ' one must stand up for prayer in no other disposition but that of humility.—Snh. 4 a לא נתן א' שלשה he did only three times. Ber. I, 1 ולא זו בלבד (אמרו) א' וכ' and not only in this case they said so, but wherever &c. Ib. 5 a אל תקרי תְלַמְּדֶנּוּ א' תְלַמְּדֵנוּ read not th’lamm’dennu (thou instructest him) but th’lamm’dēnu (thou teachest us); a. v. fr.
30 b א' לא שנא but (the conclusion is proven) there is no difference. Ib. א' אמר ר' but, said R. … we may derive it &c.; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: feixe de brotos; ramos reunidos; vassoura vegetal.

notas_originais: Y. Meg. II, 73 a (for b. h. מְטַאְטֵא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: broto jovem de palmeira; ramo fino e pontiagudo.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced.) young shoot of the palm-tree, thin pointed branch.
notas_originais: Pl. אִלְבָּנִין, אִלְבָּנַיָּיא. Cant. R. to VII, 9 the palm … has no less מן תלת אילנין אלבנין (strike out אילנין) than three new (cutting) shoots. Ib. in our place they call לאלבנייא סנסנייה the young shoots sans’naya (h. סנסנים). [Num. R. s. 3, beg., in Hebr. diction, אִנְבּוֹנִין, fr. אנב, cmp. אֵב; prob. to be read אִלְבּוֹנִין.]

notas_originais: Targ. II. Chr. II, 7 (8). [Ib. IX, 10; 11 אלמוגייא, reading the h. text as in I Kings X, 11.] V. אַלְמוּג.

verbetes.glosa_atual: lança; forquilha; estaca ou poste de sinalização em celeiro.
definicoes_originais: sign-pole, used in the barn as a mark.
notas_originais: Kel. XVI, 8 חפוי הא', v. חִפּוּי. Pes. 57 a אוי לי מֵאַלָּתָן woe to me (I am afraid) of their fork (weapon). Sabb. VI, 3 (63 a) ed. (Ms. אלא); Y. ibid. 8 b (expl. דייקרן).
Ib; Y. Maasr. I, 49 a bot.; Tosef. Ter. III, 11 משתיעקר הא' (ed. Zuck. משיתעשר, corr. acc.) as soon as the sign-pole (fork) is removed (indicating that the grain is ready for use and priestly gifts).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Deus; equivalente aramaico de אֱלֹוהַּ.
notas_originais: Dan. III, 28; a. fr.—Targ. O. Deut. XXXIII, 26; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 5, end את אלה רב Ar. (ed. אלוה). Y. B. Mets. II, 8 c אלההון דיהודאי the God of the Jews. Y. Snh. X, 28 b.— Pl. (also plur. majest.) אֱלָהִין. Dan. II, 11; a. e.—אֱלָהַיָּא. Jer. X, 11. Targ. Ps. CXXXVI, 2 אלהי אלהיא the God of gods. [Gen. R. s. 26 כומריא גנבו א' וכ' (read אלהון) when priests rob—who would swear by their god?] Ib. (ref. to Gen. VI, 2).—Lev. R. s. 33 תמן קריין … אֱלָהַיָּיא there (in Rome) they call their kings gods.

verbetes.glosa_atual: divindade; deidade; condição de deus.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 46 כדי לאלוהותו—שאין העולם the universe and what it contains, are but inadequate manifestations of his divinity; a. e. Ib. s. 66 ויתן לך אלוהותו (some ed.) may he impart to thee his divine power; v. next w.—אֱלֹוהוֹת, v. אֱלוֹהַ.
